dialogues.speaker: Diwan Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This Bulletin Board is set up by Vizier to publicize important matters in Sumeru City. Questions or doubts regarding the notices on the Bulletin Board can be posted here as well.

dialogues.speaker: Vandalized Bulletin
dialogues.text: "Notice: We are looking for experts to deal with Rishboland Tigers"

dialogues.speaker: Vandalized Bulletin
dialogues.text: The message of the notice is blotted with a paintbrush. Beside it is a sentence in slanting, childish handwriting...

dialogues.speaker: Vandalized Bulletin
dialogues.text: "Rishboland Raja just wanted to play with people!"

dialogues.speaker: Forest Watcher Announcement
dialogues.text: "If you see dancing fairies after consuming mushrooms, please do not be alarmed. It is a normal reaction."

dialogues.speaker: Forest Watcher Announcement
dialogues.text: "But if the plants around you are starting to speak, please seek help from the nearest Forest Ranger immediately."

dialogues.speaker: Forest Watcher Announcement
dialogues.text: "Due to unknown reasons, The Withering has been showing signs of expansion in both quantity and size throughout the forest."

dialogues.speaker: Forest Watcher Announcement
dialogues.text: "Not only does The Withering cause vegetation in the area to wilt, it may also be lethal to wildlife and even humans. The Forest Watchers have set up Contamination Zones to mark the area under the influence of The Withering. Please stay away from such areas."

dialogues.speaker: Forest Watcher Announcement
dialogues.text: "If you notice a new patch of The Withering in the forest, please contact a nearby Forest Ranger to have it handled professionally."

dialogues.speaker: Matra Announcement
dialogues.text: The matra have discovered multiple cases of illegal Canned Knowledge trade during recent inspections in local bazaars.

dialogues.speaker: Matra Announcement
dialogues.text: Trading of Canned Knowledge is prohibited by the Akademiya and will be severely punished upon discovery.

dialogues.speaker: Matra Announcement
dialogues.text: The Akademiya will not be held responsible for any consequences of illegal usage of Canned Knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The annual Sabzeruz Festival is just around the corner. A grand festival will be held in the Grand Bazaar same as last year."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "To heat up the festive ambiance, our lady has prepared a special subsidy for all participating merchants."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Let's celebrate Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday together!"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Our lady left home and still hasn't returned. If you see a young girl with brown hair wearing a blue and purple dress, please contact the Homayani family. You will be duly thanked for your help!"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "If our lady herself sees this poster, please contact us immediately. Your parents are very worried about you."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "He's back! My Lord, Al-Ahmar, is back!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The day he returns will be the day of retribution for all you leaf-heads!"

dialogues.speaker: Matra Announcement
dialogues.text: This is fake news, and we are currently investigating its source. All matters in Sumeru are posted regularly in the Akasha. Please do not trust any rumors.

dialogues.speaker: Lord Sangemah Bay
dialogues.text: "My friend, are you troubled by anything? Look no further! The Almighty Lord Sangemah Bay is here to give you all the answers you seek."

dialogues.speaker: Lord Sangemah Bay
dialogues.text: "All it costs is a little Mora, and all your problems will be resolved in no time."

dialogues.speaker: Lord Sangemah Bay
dialogues.text: "Take action before it's too late! Contact information..."

dialogues.speaker: Diwan Notice
dialogues.text: This Bulletin Board is set up by Sir Vizier to regulate market transactions. Please do not post any advertisements here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Does anyone know where to find an excellent storyteller? It has to be someone who can tell a story exactly as it is."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'm being haunted by a terrifying Jinni. It's threatening to kill me if I don't tell it the exact same story every day. It's been a month now, and my brain is turning to mush from this torture..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "What a strange experience. But I've heard of a storyteller called Maddah in Puspa Café. He might be able to help you."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I've been to many nations and watched countless performances. There isn't a shred of doubt in me that Nilou is the best dancer in Teyvat. But not only were the pedants from the Akademiya unable to appreciate her performance, they even complained about it! What an insult to art!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Based on my experience in Mondstadt, we should organize a fan club for Nilou. Then those people who don't know anything about art wouldn't dare to insult her again."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "A fan club... Is that a part of Mondstadt's culture? Anyway... A perfect performance is a joint effort of everyone in the troupe. Placing all the attention on a single person is just not fair."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Moreover, I believe that art itself is a bond that brings people together. I'm very happy that you enjoyed Nilou's performance."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Based on that elegant handwriting, you must be a young lady, right? It's so good to know that there's someone else who enjoys watching dance performances. May I ask if you would like to have a cup of coffee together sometime?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I'm very busy. Please speak to my manager if you need any help."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Looks like this guy got rejected. The final message is clearly written by a tough man... he's probably the bodyguard of a rich lady or something."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Magic bottles for sale. Magic bottles that can harness the power of spirits. Please leave your payment here. Grants any wish, only one Mora."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Magic bottles for sale. Magic bottles that grant any wishes. The price is only one Mora."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'm a Jinni. Just give me one Mora and I'll grant any wish of yours."

dialogues.speaker: Citadel of Regzar Announcement
dialogues.text: "The Citadel of Regzar is investigating the recent string of scams. Please do not panic."

dialogues.speaker: Citadel of Regzar Announcement
dialogues.text: "Any victims who have further questions may seek consultation for just one Mora."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Ever since I became a Forest Watcher, I spent all my time in the forest. If this keeps up, I'm gonna start talking to Dusk Birds."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If only I could understand them... I wouldn't be as bored as I am now."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I hired a pretty decent mercenary a while ago. I think she's called Flame-Mane or something..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I brought her along with me each time I went out to the sea for business. Doesn't matter if it's Treasure Hoarders or the Millelith — with her by my side, there was nothing to fear. I made a fortune all thanks to her."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But I don't think I've seen her accepting any commissions lately, and I heard monsters have increased in number on the path to Liyue... I may have to put my money in the Kalimi Exchange if this goes on."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "You don't sound like someone who does legit business... But if it's the Flame-Mane, I heard that she's been hired by the Homayani family. You're gonna have to wait quite a while before she's available again."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "And a word of advice, your money will be better spent buying 100 carpets than investing in the Kalimi Exchange!"

dialogues.speaker: Sulaykha Carpets
dialogues.text: "You're absolutely right! Please visit our shop to buy some carpets! I can even explain in detail about how you can use each of them!"

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: If you encounter anyone with a blank gaze or muttering to themselves in the forest, they are researchers in Satyavada Life. Please do not disturb them.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: If they cause any concern, please report it to the Mahamata for proper handling of the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I heard that Diwan used to be an organization that spoke out for us downtown commoners, but now it just obeys whatever the Mahamata say."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Vizier too. That man never keeps his word. He's only there when the Mahamata tries to shed responsibility."

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: The Akademiya's guidance to all administrative bodies is based on the guidance of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata. Please refrain from slander.

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Poem
dialogues.text: "The city of wisdom is ours, as is the forest of ignorance. Atop the tree lies the remnants of the kingdom of lost dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I heard that Diwan used to be an organization that spoke out for us downtown commoners, but now it just obeys whatever the Mahamata say."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Vizier too. That man never keeps his word. He's only there when the Mahamata tries to shed responsibility."

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: The Akademiya's role is to provide guidance to all administrative bodies. Please refrain from slander.
